additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
First Chargring session starting Fri, 13 Jun 2025 09:00:48 GMT.
After that --> Replugging because charging interruption.
Our customer sent us a charging diagramm, where it is visibale,
that on the Power is shifiting up and down for no specific reason
due to DPA of SiD.
Why is the charger doing that?
THere was a ELMS via Modbus before, which is now turned off - so
this should not be a factor anymore!
Can you help us here as soon as possible please?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431070-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S0 170004171] Charging Interruption CRM:02699000126
additional_info.body:
Dear Nenad,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team.
Thank you so much for your support during the charging session. Even though we were not able to reproduce the error in the field today, I found the issue from log analysis. In this ticket, actually two issues are highlighted: one is the charging interruption at 2025-06-13T09:05:40.000000, and another one is the fluctuating power delivery after.
Issue 1:
Charging Interruption at 2025 -06-13T09:05:40.000000 --> The charging session has been stopped by the EV while the charger delivers 500A. There is no EcoG log available for the SECC log analysis. As there are no error flags from the charger side to stop the charging session, it should be from the EV side.
Proof:
SECC[847]: {"type":"stop_charging","timestamp":1749805539997,"chargerId":"secc2300-17460","outlet":"2","outletType":"CCS","payload":{"source":"EV","user":"internal"}}
Issue 2:
Charger output power fluctuating with respect to power converter fault --> toggling E17 error flag on PowerConverter[X]-2102313PAVNSQ6000873SA022204000204FW:DC903PF903H100) causing the power fluctuation while charging.
Upon checking, the E17 error flag associated with the particular converter shows that it is out of limit and badly affecting the charger operation. I am requesting you to proceed with the replacement of the faulty converter from the charger (the converter belongs to DC1-2102313PAVNSQ6000873).
Note:
Detailed analysis is attached to the ISP ticket as note
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
